content: ATS-friendly PDF consensus: single column, no tables/text boxes/headers-footers, standard readable font, plain bullets (-, *, bullet), straight quotes and hyphens, no em dashes or decorative symbols, text must be selectable (real text layer), standard section headings (Experience, Education, Skills), reverse chronological, 1-2 pages. PDF vs DOCX disputed; recent sources favor text-based PDF unless posting says otherwise. Accented characters: some sources say avoid, most silent; keep them in Spanish version, ensure proper Unicode text layer.
